scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix frontend
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it kyiv-malyn-postgres psql -U booking -d booking
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:up && npm --prefix backend run prisma:migrate:deploy && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix backend run seed:transport
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
